SELECT pp.project_id, pp.LEASE_ITEM_ID, pp.hd_id, pp.source_id, hli.FULL_NAME AS LEASE_ITEM_ID_N, hli.LEASE_ITEM_CODE, hli.LEASE_ITEM_TYPE, ( SELECT meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v WHERE CODE = 'HLS.COLLATERAL_TYPE' AND code_value = hli.LEASE_ITEM_TYPE ) LEASE_ITEM_TYPE_N, hli.PATTERN, ( SELECT meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v WHERE CODE = 'HLS.PATTERN' AND code_value = hli.PATTERN ) PATTERN_N, hli.MORTGAGOR, ( SELECT hbm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE hbm.bp_id = hli.MORTGAGOR ) MORTGAGOR_N, hli.PLEDGE_STATE, ( SELECT meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v WHERE CODE = 'PLEDGE_STATE0' AND code_value = hli.PLEDGE_STATE ) PLEDGE_STATE_N, ( SELECT a.EVALUATION_VALUE FROM ( SELECT hlid.lease_item_id, sum(hlid.EVALUATION_VALUE) AS EVALUATION_VALUE FROM hls_lease_item_detail hlid GROUP BY hlid.lease_item_id ) a WHERE a.lease_item_id = hli.lease_item_id ) ASSET_VALUE_TOTAL, ( SELECT sum(a.v1 + a.v2) FROM ( SELECT hlid.lease_item_id, sum(hlid.purchase_price) AS v1, sum(hlid.pledge_asset_value) AS v2 FROM hls_lease_item_detail hlid GROUP BY hlid.lease_item_id ) a WHERE a.lease_item_id = hli.lease_item_id ) ORIGINAL_ASSET_VALUE_TOTAL FROM hls_duration_item pp, hls_lease_item hli
hli.LEASE_ITEM_ID = pp.LEASE_ITEM_ID AND hli.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND hli.LEASE_ITEM_TYPE IN ('MORTGAGE', 'PLEDGE') AND pp.source_type = 'PLEDGOR_MORTGAGORS' and pp.hd_id = #{hdId}

SELECT hcli.project_id, hcli.LEASE_ITEM_ID, hcli.hd_id, hcli.source_id, hli.FULL_NAME AS LEASE_ITEM_ID_N, hli.LEASE_ITEM_CODE, hli.INSTALLATION_SITE AS IDENTIFICATION_CITY, hli.DESCRIPTION, hli.vender_id, hli.BRAND, hli.LEASE_ITEM_TYPE, ( SELECT CASE WHEN ( SELECT max(lal.fair_value) FROM lease_asset_ln lal WHERE lal.LEASE_ITEM_ID = hlil.LEASE_ITEM_ID ) IS NULL THEN sum(hlil.PRICE * hlil.QUANTITY) ELSE ( SELECT max(lal.fair_value) FROM lease_asset_ln lal WHERE lal.LEASE_ITEM_ID = hlil.LEASE_ITEM_ID ) END AS ASSET_VALUE_TOTAL FROM hls_lease_item_list hlil WHERE hli.LEASE_ITEM_ID = hlil.LEASE_ITEM_ID ) NET_ASSET_VALUE_TOTAL, ( SELECT hbm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE hbm.bp_id = hli.vender_id ) VENDER_ID_N, ( SELECT scv.MEANING FROM sys_code_b sc, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID AND sc.CODE = 'ASSET_STATUS' AND scv.VALUE = hli.asset_status ) asset_status_n FROM hls_duration_item hcli, hls_lease_item hli
hli.LEASE_ITEM_ID = hcli.LEASE_ITEM_ID AND hli.enabled_flag = 'Y' AND hli.LEASE_ITEM_TYPE = 'LEASE' AND hcli.source_type = 'LEASE_ITEMS' and hcli.hd_id = #{hdId}
